name: Hypercapacitor Gizmo
summary: In Thousand Needles, the Hypercapacitor Gizmo lies among the wreckage of a goblin caravan. A caged panther wore it around its neck, and even its owner does not know what it does.

sections.title: A Caravan's Strange Relic
sections.body: Centaur marauders ambushed a goblin caravan crossing Thousand Needles and plundered nearly everything. Wizlo Bearingshiner, the lone survivor, crawled to safety at Whitereach Post. He left his best gizmo behind, fastened around the neck of a ferocious, enraged panther locked in a transport cage. The centaur feared the beast and left the cage untouched in the burning wreckage.

sections.title: Tinkering in the Dark
sections.body: Wizlo proudly calls the Hypercapacitor Gizmo his best gizmo, though he admits he has no idea what it does. The device tangles ambition with volatile parts. Wizlo can only keep tinkering, unsure what practical use it might have.

faq.answer: The Hypercapacitor Gizmo belongs to Wizlo Bearingshiner, a goblin engineer. Even Wizlo does not know what it does, so he intends to study it until he discovers its purpose.

faq.q: How did the device end up around a panther's neck?
faq.answer: Centaur attacked and ransacked Wizlo's caravan in northern Thousand Needles. In the chaos, the device was fastened around the neck of an enraged panther in a traveling cage. The superstitious centaur feared the beast and left it alone.

faq.q: Who wants the Hypercapacitor Gizmo back?
faq.answer: Wizlo Bearingshiner wants the Hypercapacitor Gizmo back. The caravan's sole survivor has taken refuge at Whitereach Post, a Tauren encampment in northwestern Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Why didn't the centaur steal it?
faq.answer: The centaur ransacked the caravan but feared the ferocious panther in its cage. They left the beast and its metal collar untouched among the ruins.

angles.text: The gizmo has the feel of goblin engineering: an intricate device with a grand name, built with enthusiasm before anyone decided what it should do.
Travelers who aid Whitereach Post help drive off aggressive centaur and recover lost oddities from ruined caravans across the canyon floor.
